parameters.query:
WITH srv AS (
  SELECT * FROM resolver_servicio($2) LIMIT 1
),
fecha_valida AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $1 ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN $1::date
    WHEN $1 ~* 'mañana' THEN ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date + INTERVAL '1 day')::date
    ELSE (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date
  END AS f
),
slots AS (
  SELECT d.slot_inicio
  FROM srv, fecha_valida fv,
  LATERAL consultar_disponibilidad(fv.f, srv.duracion_minutos, $3) d
)
SELECT
  (SELECT nombre FROM srv) AS servicio,
  (SELECT duracion_minutos FROM srv) AS duracion_minutos,
  (SELECT to_char(f, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM fecha_valida) AS fecha_consultada,
  COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(to_char(slot_inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'HH24:MI'), ',' ORDER BY slot_inicio) FROM slots), '') AS slots_24h;
